{{Quote|Supply craft ''1729'', you are cleared to land. Opening shield now.|The controller, in a transmission to ''1729''{{'s}} captain|<ref name="SWBHg" />}}
A '''landing controller''' worked at [[Desolation Alley]], a [[Republic Correctional Authority/Legends|Republic Correctional Authority]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. When the [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] ''[[1729]]'' entered the [[Oovo system/Legends|Oovo system]], the controller gave the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Unidentified captain (1729)|captain]] permission to land. The controller temporarily deactivated the [[Particle shield/Legends|shields]] surrounding the prison asteroid so that ''1729'' could enter, not knowing that [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had concealed [[Jaster's Legacy|his ship]] behind ''1729'' in order to infiltrate the prison.<ref name="SWBHg" />

==Behind the scenes==
The landing controller's voice appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''. They were voiced by [[Jan Rabson]], credited for additional voices under "Prison guard #2."<ref name="SWBHg" />
